Position Summary 		   Total Duration 50   working  days
Note: Payment shall only   be  made after submission   of  a report   and  relevant deliverables   for  each milestone,   to  be reviewed   and  approved by   the  National Malaria Program.
Objective   and  Justification
The primary objective   of  hiring   a  Technical Assistant (TA)   is  to develop   and  expand common MIS modules that can   be  reused across malaria, TB, HIV,   and  other relevant health programs.
The specific objectives   are  to:
• Assess   and  refine requirements   for  common MIS functions.
• Develop   or  expand e-training   and  certification functionality.
• Develop   or  expand administrative division management functionality.
• Develop   or  expand alert   and  notification functionality.
• Develop   or  expand stock management functionality   for  RDTs, ACTs, LLINs, laboratory commodities,   and  other relevant commodities.
• Ensure   the  modules   are  integrated   with  common master data,   existing  MIS components,   and  approved external systems   as  appropriate.
Scope   of  Work
The selected TA   will  work closely   with  the Head   of  the MIS Unit, relevant CNM teams,   program  focal points, developers,   and  technical counterparts.   The  TA   will  assess   existing  functionality, develop   or  expand common modules, integrate   them  with   the  MIS, conduct testing,   and  support implementation   and  handover.
Duties & Responsibilities:
•  Assessment   and  Functional Planning
•  Review   existing  MIS modules   and  identify functionality that can   be  reused   or  expanded across programs.
•  Consult relevant users   and  program focal points   to  identify common requirements.
•  Define functional requirements, workflows, user roles,   data  requirements,   and  integration needs.
•  Develop   a  detailed technical   development  and implementation plan.
•  E-Training   and  Certification
•  Develop   or  enhance course   and  training management functionality.
•  Support user enrollment, learning content, assessments, completion tracking,   and  training history.
•  Support pre-test/post-test   and  scoring functionality where required.
•  Develop certification   and  certificate management functionality.
•  Provide training   and  certification reporting by user, program, administrative area,   and  other relevant dimensions.
•  Alert   and  Notification
•  Develop configurable system alerts   based  on defined   business  rules   and  conditions.
•  Support alerts   related  to stock levels, expiry, reporting, training, certification,   and  other   program  events.
•  Support user-   and  role-specific notifications.
•  Support in-system notifications and, where technically approved
•  Provide configuration options   for  authorized administrators   to  manage alert rules.
•  Stock Management
•  Develop   or  enhance commodity master   data  and stock management functions.
•  Support stock receipt, issue/distribution, transfer, adjustment,   and  balance management.
•  Support batch/lot   and  expiry-date tracking where required.
•  Support minimum   and  maximum stock levels   and  stock alerts.
•  Cover RDTs, ACTs, LLINs, laboratory commodities,   and  other relevant   program  commodities.
•  Provide facility-level   and  program-level stock visibility   and  reporting.
•  Integrate stock management   with  common facility   and  commodity master   data  and relevant external systems where appropriate.
•  Testing, Documentation   and  Handover
•  Conduct unit, integration, functional,   and  user acceptance testing   as  appropriate.
•  Address identified bugs,   data  issues,   and  performance problems.
•  Apply role-based access control, audit trails, secure   development  practices,   and  cybersecurity requirements.
•  Develop user manuals, administrator guidance, technical documentation,   and  API documentation where applicable.
•  Provide deployment support, knowledge transfer,   and  handover   to  the MIS/IT team.
•  Expected Outputs
•  Functional   and  technical specifications   for  the common MIS modules.
•  Enhanced e-training   and  certification module.
•  Enhanced alert   and  notification module.
•  Enhanced stock management module covering RDTs, ACTs, LLINs, laboratory commodities,   and  other relevant commodities.
•  APIs   or  other integration components required   for  approved system integration.
•  Testing, user acceptance, bug fixing, documentation, deployment support,   and  knowledge transfer completed.
Expected Profile of Candidates
Qualifications:
•  Bachelor's Degree   in  Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Health Informatics,   or  another   related  field
Work History:
•  Software development, information system implementation,   or  system integration for  5  years  as a minimum
Skills & Knowledge:
General & Technical Skills
•  Demonstrated experience developing web-based information systems, modular applications, databases, APIs,   and  integration solutions.
•  Experience   with  e-learning, workflow, notification, logistics, stock management,   or  similar systems   is  desirable.
•  Strong knowledge   of  database technologies, APIs, role-based access control,   and  secure   application  development.
•  Experience   with  health information systems   or  government information systems   is  an advantage.
•  Ability   to  work   and  coordinate effectively   with  multiple technical   and  program stakeholders.
•  Familiarity   with  the health system   in  Cambodia   is  desired.
•  Experience   in  malaria, TB, HIV, logistics,   or  public health   is  desired.
